meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: Claude 会为 NanoClaw 添加 Microsoft Teams 支持：从 channels 分支拷入 Teams 适配器、注册并安装依赖、跑注册测试，再用 Teams CLI 创建机器人、写入凭据，并把助手接到指定的 Teams 账号。
howto.when: 当你要把 Teams 接入 NanoClaw 时触发。需要能创建 Entra 应用并侧载的 Microsoft 365 账号，以及转发到本机 3000 端口的 HTTPS 端点，否则流程会停下。

say.text: 帮我把 Teams 接进来
say.note: 会拷适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 用 Teams CLI 创建机器人，名字叫 NanoClaw
say.note: 会注册 Entra 应用、生成密钥并给出安装链接

say.text: 把助手接到我这个 Teams 账号上
say.note: 会创建机器人与你的 1:1 会话，由助手先发消息

howto.what_en: Claude adds Microsoft Teams support: it copies the Teams adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned package, runs the registration test, then uses the Teams CLI to create the bot and wire a Teams account.
howto.when_en: Runs when you want to add Teams to NanoClaw. It needs a Microsoft 365 account that can create Entra apps and sideload, plus an HTTPS endpoint forwarding to this machine's webhook port 3000.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams to my NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs it and runs the test

say_en.text: Create the Teams bot named NanoClaw
say_en.note: Registers the Entra app and returns an install link

say_en.text: Wire the assistant to my Teams account
say_en.note: Opens a 1:1 chat so the assistant messages you first
